question: Across fixed cumulative post-target ordinary-noise reference horizons, how does the unchanged shipping NS noise state respond relative to the post-NS local observation trajectory, and does the I033 mismatch look more like tracker inertia or a persistent domain/scale mismatch?

causal_anchor_semantics.target: first oracle-speech disagreement frame with fewer than eight prior same-case ordinary-noise non-disagreement references
causal_anchor_semantics.anchor: last strictly prior same-case ordinary-noise non-disagreement reference

fixed_temporal_response_semantics.horizon_definition: first N strictly post-target ordinary-noise non-disagreement references
fixed_temporal_response_semantics.ns_response_delta: median ns_noise_rms_dbfs over first N post-target references minus anchor ns_noise_rms_dbfs
fixed_temporal_response_semantics.local_response_delta: median post_ns_rms_dbfs over first N post-target references minus anchor post_ns_rms_dbfs
fixed_temporal_response_semantics.alignment_error: NS response delta minus local response delta at the same fixed horizon
fixed_temporal_response_semantics.elapsed_frames_role: descriptive timing only; report target-to-Nth-reference elapsed frames without selecting a lag
fixed_temporal_response_semantics.post_target_evidence_role: retrospective diagnostic evidence only; never a causal input or refresh source

diagnostic_outputs: per-case causal target and last-prior-reference anchor identity
NS and local response deltas at every fixed horizon
signed/absolute alignment error at every fixed horizon
target-to-horizon elapsed frame counts as descriptive timing only
fixed-horizon coverage and exact shipping mirror identity

decision_contract.NS_VAD_NOISE_STATE_TEMPORAL_RESPONSE_DEC: Fresh target-only authority, causal anchor/target extraction, all fixed reference horizons, coverage and shipping mirrors are valid. Report the fixed-horizon response trajectory for review without selecting any lag, alpha, refresh rule, mapping, threshold or source candidate.
decision_contract.I034_INPUT_INVALID_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Dataset identity, fresh-seed identity, causal target count, anchor count/coverage, fixed-horizon coverage or shipping-mirror preconditions fail.

next_review: Review whether fixed-horizon NS response materially catches up with the post-NS local trajectory. I034 itself cannot select a horizon, lag, tracker alpha, mapping, refresh rule, threshold or source candidate. A subsequent authority must be preregistered from the reviewed I034 result.
